description: Book the free 15-minute consultation call at one of the times returned by get_available_slots. Confirm the exact time (in Pacific Time), full name, and email with the user before calling. Fill the optional intake fields from what the user has already shared in conversation — don't interrogate; at most ask one or two natural follow-ups (who the meals are for, dietary needs, ZIP). The customer receives a confirmation email; a Well Prepped Life team member calls them at the booked time.

biggest_challenge.description: Their main food/meal challenge right now, e.g. 'mom stopped cooking after her fall'. Fill from conversation if shared.

care_recipient.description: Who the meals are for: self, parent, spouse, other family member, client, or friend. Fill from conversation if mentioned.

dietary_needs.description: Dietary needs or restrictions: diabetic-friendly, kidney-friendly, low-sodium, soft food, allergies, dislikes. Fill from conversation if mentioned.

email.description: Customer's email address (confirmation is sent here).

heard_about.description: How they heard about Well Prepped Life (if mentioned).

meals_per_week.description: Roughly how many meals per week they need.

notes.description: Any other context for the call not covered by the structured fields below.

phone.description: Customer's phone number — strongly recommended, this is a phone consultation.

start.description: Chosen slot start time as a UTC ISO string, exactly as returned by get_available_slots.

start_when.description: How soon they want meals to start, e.g. 'this week', 'next month', 'after hospital discharge'.

zip.description: Delivery ZIP code (SF Bay Area — Peninsula & South Bay).

name: book_consultation
